concept.hr: Izbalansiran prsten dioda potiskuje nositelj; ostaju samo dva bočna pojasa
concept.en: A balanced diode ring suppresses the carrier and leaves only the two sidebands

summary.hr: Balansni modulator s prstenom dioda i potenciometrom za podešavanje nositelja: izlaz u vremenu i spektar, s ostatkom nositelja kad sklop nije izbalansiran.
summary.en: A diode-ring balanced modulator with a carrier balance potentiometer: the output over time and its spectrum, with residual carrier when off balance.

what.hr: Simulacija applet_dsp.html (sklop balansnog modulatora s prstenom dioda i njegove vrijednosti) i tekst odjeljka o modulatorima (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The simulation applet_dsp.html (the diode-ring balanced modulator circuit and its values) and the text of the modulators section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Sklop se računa na stranici i crta bez vanjskog simulatora sklopova, prilagođen simdeck kitu, preveden na engleski, dodani spektar s označenim nositeljem i bočnim pojasevima, klizači za NF signal i unaprijed postavljene vrijednosti
changes.en: The circuit is calculated on the page and drawn without an outside circuit simulator, adapted to the simdeck kit, translated into English, a spectrum with the carrier and sidebands marked, sliders for the AF signal and presets added
